info.title: Submitator API
info.summary: Launch your clients' products on directories, under your brand.
info.description:
Create a project for each of your clients, launch it, and follow every directory listing until it is live. One launch covers up to 100 directories for one project.

Send your key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Keys that start with `sbm_live_` work on real listings; keys that start with `sbm_test_` run a simulation and spend nothing.

Requests and responses are JSON. Ids are strings with a type prefix, such as `prj_` for projects, and times are ISO 8601 in UTC. Lists page with cursors, and every error has the same shape, with a stable `code` and a `doc_url`.

Guides, a quickstart, the error reference and the versioning policy live at https://submitator.com/docs.

servers.description: Production. The key decides whether a request runs in live or test mode.

tags.name: Basics
tags.description:
Check your key, read your account and download this reference. Every request needs `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. The key's prefix decides the mode, and an id from one mode is never found in the other.

Ids are a type prefix (`prj_`, `lst_`, `dir_`, `evt_`, `rep_`, `img_`, `we_`, `wd_`, `key_`) and 22 letters and digits: treat them as opaque strings. Times are ISO 8601 in UTC. Lists return `object`, `data`, `has_more` and `next_cursor`; send `next_cursor` back as `cursor` to read the next page.

Send JSON with `Content-Type: application/json`; image uploads also accept `multipart/form-data`. A parameter the operation does not list returns 400 `unknown_parameter`, and an empty string counts as `null`.

Each account and mode can make 3,600 requests per UTC hour, or 600 before your first purchase. Every response carries `X-Request-Id`, and a request your key authenticates also gets `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset` for your account and mode. Errors share one envelope: branch on `error.code`, show `error.message`, and quote `error.request_id` when you contact support.

tags.name: Projects
tags.description:
A project is one of your client's products. Create it from a URL and we fill in what the site tells us; then add a logo, 1 to 5 screenshots and a contact email.

A draft costs nothing and you can delete it. Once launched, a project stays: it cannot be deleted, and its `contact_email` can no longer change.

tags.name: Launch
tags.description:
Preview, pick, launch and follow the listings. `GET /projects/{project_id}/readiness` is free and shows what a launch would do, and `GET /projects/{project_id}/directories` what each directory is to the project; `POST /projects/{project_id}/launch` uses 1 launch and creates up to 100 listings, one per directory.

A launch, and an add after it, takes `auto`, an `include` list or an `exclude` list, and `excluded_directories` to replace the project's exclusions in the same request. An article platform goes only by `include`; auto-replace never adds one, nor an excluded directory.

A listing moves `pending` → `in_progress` → `submitted` → `live`, or ends `not_accepted` or `cancelled`. When it waits on you or your client it shows `action_required` with an `action` to take. Listing times are rounded down to the hour.

tags.name: Badge
tags.description:
Some directories list a product only while their badge shows on the product's site. One feed serves every badge a project needs, under your agency's brand: your client installs it once and new badges appear by themselves.

Get the install kit, forward `client_message` to your client, then verify. Until the badge is verified, those directories stay out of the launch and appear in `readiness.unlocks`.

tags.name: Reports
tags.description:
PDF and XLSX reports of a project's listings, prepared under your agency's name. Build one, wait until it is `ready`, and download it within 7 days.

Send `include_logins: true` to add the directory logins and their password, for your client to take over the accounts. Such a report never appears on a share link's page, and only a key with full permissions downloads it.

tags.name: Events
tags.description:
Every change to your projects, listings and reports, in order. Events are kept for 90 days. Read the feed with a cursor to keep your records in sync, or receive the same events as webhooks.

An event's `created_at` is exact to the second and shows when the change was recorded, within about a minute of the change itself. Listing times inside the event stay rounded down to the hour.

The feed has no gaps: a cursor returns every event recorded after it, in order. Each change sends one event, and a launch sends `project.launched` once instead of one event per new listing.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description:
Events pushed to your HTTPS endpoint as they happen. Each delivery is a POST with the event as JSON, signed as Standard Webhooks describes: verify it with an official Standard Webhooks library and your `whsec_` secret.

Answer with any 2xx within 10 seconds (5 seconds to connect); redirects are not followed. A failed delivery is retried after 1 minute, 5 minutes, 30 minutes, 2 hours, 6 hours and 24 hours, then marked `failed`. An endpoint with no successful delivery for 72 hours and at least 10 failed events is disabled and you get an email; `PATCH` it with `enabled: true` to turn it back on.

Deliveries can arrive out of order. Compare `data.previous_status`, or read the object again, before you act on an older event.

tags.name: Directories
tags.description:
The catalog a launch picks from, highest Domain Rating first. Domain Rating (DR) is a 0 to 100 score of a site's backlink profile, measured by Ahrefs.

`kind` tells a directory from an article platform, where the listing is a post about the product. A launch or an add takes an article platform only when you name it in `include`: `auto`, `exclude` and auto-replace never take one.

`outdated` marks a directory that lately seems to publish few new products. It is a sign, not a verdict, and it changes nothing a launch picks.

`backlink_condition` says what a `dofollow` link depends on: `badge` for a directory that links dofollow only while its badge is on the product's site. Verify the project's badge before a launch or an add takes one.

`GET /projects/{project_id}/directories` shows what each directory is to one project: what `auto` would take, what else you can name, and what is excluded, listed or locked, with the reason. Pick from it and send your pick as `include`.

Before your first purchase, test keys see the top 20 directories only, and no article platform.

tags.name: Test mode
tags.description:
With a `sbm_test_` key every call works as in live mode, on separate data, and nothing is submitted or spent. Share links are the one exception: a client page needs a live project, so creating one answers 422 `validation_failed` and reading or turning one off answers 404. Listings move on their own: `in_progress` after 1 to 5 minutes, `submitted` after 3 to 8 minutes and an outcome after 6 to 15 minutes, where 80% go `live`, 12% end `not_accepted` and 8% stay `submitted`. The outcome depends only on the listing's id, so a listing always ends the same way.

Apart from webhook deliveries, nothing leaves our servers in test mode. Image URLs are not downloaded and files are checked but not stored, feed URLs have the right shape but return 404, and autofill and Domain Ratings are simulated. Hosts on `.test` and `.example` are accepted here and rejected in live mode.

Logins are placeholders: about 45% of test listings get one, on the project's contact email or on an address at `login.test`, with a password made from the project's id and sample emails whose links point to `login.test`. Nothing signs up anywhere.

Two inputs fail on purpose: a host that starts with `nobadge.` never passes badge verification, and an image URL ending in `/fail.png` returns `image_unreachable`. Test data is deleted after 30 days without activity.

tags.name: Share links
tags.description:
A read-only page that shows your client how their launch is going, in your agency's name and colors. It lists live directories with links, the ones still in progress and the latest reports, and shows no prices.

Each project has at most one active link. Creating a new link turns the old URL off.

tags.name: Logins
tags.description:
The accounts created for your client on directories that need one: where each signs in, its email and username, whether it is ready, and the one password they all use. Hand them to your client, so your client owns the listings.

Logins are credentials. A read-only key gets 403 `permission_denied`, responses carry `Cache-Control: no-store`, and logins never appear in events or webhooks.

apiKey.description:
Send a secret key in the `Authorization` header: `Authorization: Bearer $SUBMITATOR_API_KEY`. A key is `sbm_live_` or `sbm_test_`, 8 letters or digits, an underscore and 43 more.

Live keys work on real listings and come with your first purchase. Test keys run a simulation, spend nothing and are free. Create, roll and revoke keys in the console, which shows a new key once.

Keep keys on your server: never put one in a browser, an app or a repository.

Limit.description: How many items to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A unique string, such as a UUID, that makes a retry safe. A success is kept for 24 hours: a repeat with the same key and body returns it again with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`, and the same key with another body returns 422 `idempotency_key_reused`. A repeat while the first request runs returns 409 `idempotency_key_in_use`. An error changes nothing, so a repeat after one runs again.

WebhookId.name: webhook-id
WebhookId.description: The event's id. Every attempt of the same event to the same endpoint carries the same value: store it and skip deliveries you have already handled.

WebhookTimestamp.name: webhook-timestamp
WebhookTimestamp.description: When this attempt was signed, in Unix seconds. Reject a delivery whose timestamp is more than 5 minutes from your clock; the official libraries do this for you.

WebhookSignature.name: webhook-signature
WebhookSignature.description:
One or more signatures separated by spaces, each `v1,` and a base64 HMAC-SHA256. The signed text is `{webhook-id}.{webhook-timestamp}.{body}`, with the raw body exactly as received, and the key is your secret after `whsec_`, base64-decoded. For 24 hours after you roll a secret, each delivery carries 2 signatures, one per secret: accept the delivery when any of them matches.

The official Standard Webhooks libraries for Node, Python, Ruby, PHP and Go check all of this: pass them the headers, the raw body and your `whsec_` secret.

- `listed`: the project has it; `listing` is the listing.
- `locked`: the project cannot take it, even from `include`; `reason` and `message` say why.
- `excluded`: it is in the project's `excluded_directories`, so `auto` and auto-replace skip it. `include` still takes it.

- `open`: you can name it in `include`: a directory beyond `limit`, or an article platform, which only `include` takes.

- `badge`, `competitors`, `promo_code`: it needs the badge verified on the site, at least 1 competitor, or a promo code.
- `contact_email`: it registers the listing to the contact email, which the project does not have yet.
- `b2b_only`, `ai_only`, `directories_only`: it takes only that kind of product, as `audience` says.
- `other`: it needs more than one of these, or it is closed for a reason no project field changes.

- `completed`: no listing is `pending`, `in_progress` or `action_required`, and auto-replace has nothing to add. Listings in `submitted` can still go live.
- `draft`: not launched yet.

status.description:
Where the listing stands:

- `pending`: waiting to start. Listings start as capacity frees: up to 100 of yours are in progress at once.
- `in_progress`: being prepared and sent to the directory.
- `action_required`: waiting on you or your client; `action` says what.
- `submitted`: the directory has it and is reviewing it.
- `live`: published; `live_url` points to it.
- `not_accepted`: the directory declined it, could not take it, or took it down; `reason` says which.
- `cancelled`: withdrawn before it reached the directory.

The usual path is `pending` → `in_progress` ⇄ `action_required` → `submitted` → `live`, and some listings go live without `submitted`. Rare corrections each send their own event: `live` → `not_accepted` (`removed`), `live` → `submitted`, and `not_accepted` or `cancelled` → `pending`, `in_progress`, `submitted` or `live`. The console and reports show the statuses as Pending, In progress, Needs you, Submitted, Live, Not accepted and Cancelled.

reason.description:
Why the listing ended, for `not_accepted` and `cancelled`; `null` otherwise. New values can appear.

- `declined`: the directory reviewed the listing and said no.
- `unavailable`: the directory could not take the listing, for example because it stopped taking new products.
- `removed`: the directory took down a listing that was live.
- `withdrawn`: we withdrew the listing before it reached the directory.

Event.description:
One change. The type is always `<object>.<new status>`, and `data.previous_status` holds the status before it.

| `type` | `data.object` | `data.previous_status` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `project.launched` | project | `draft` |
| `project.listings_added` | project | `null` |
| `project.in_progress`, `project.action_required`, `project.on_hold`, `project.completed` | project | the project's status before |
| `listing.in_progress`, `listing.action_required`, `listing.submitted`, `listing.live`, `listing.not_accepted`, `listing.cancelled` | listing | the listing's status before |
| `report.ready`, `report.failed` | report | `building` |
| `ping` | webhook endpoint | `null` |

A listing that returns to `pending` after a correction sends no event; the next one is `listing.in_progress`.

ErrorCode.description:
The stable part of an error. The list is closed: every code we return is here, and each has a section at its `doc_url`.

| Code | Status | What happened | How to fix |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `invalid_json` | 400 | The body is not valid JSON. | Send a JSON object with `Content-Type: application/json`. |
| `invalid_query` | 400 | The query string cannot be read: a `%` is not followed by two hex digits. | Percent-encode the values, for example with `encodeURIComponent`. |
| `unknown_parameter` | 400 | A body field or query parameter is not part of this operation; `param` names it. | Remove it. The key sets the mode, so `livemode` is never a parameter. |
| `invalid_cursor` | 400 | The cursor was not issued for this list, or it was changed. | Send `next_cursor` exactly as you received it, to the same list. |
| `api_key_missing` | 401 | The request has no key. | Send `Authorization: Bearer` and your key. |
| `api_key_invalid` | 401 | The key is unknown, revoked or expired. | Use an active key from the console. |
| `no_launches_left` | 402 | The launch needs 1 launch and you have 0. Nothing was spent. | Buy launches in the console, then send the same request again. |
| `account_suspended` | 403 | Your account is suspended: it can read but not write. | Contact support. |
| `permission_denied` | 403 | A read-only key tried to write, or to read logins. | Use a key with full permissions. |
| `test_mode_only` | 403 | A live key called a test helper. | Call test helpers with a `sbm_test_` key. |
| `not_found` | 404 | Nothing with this id in the key's mode. | Check the id, and that the key's mode matches the object's. |
| `route_not_found` | 404 | No operation at this path. | Check the path against the reference. |
| `method_not_allowed` | 405 | The path exists, but not with this HTTP method. | Use a method the reference lists for the path. |
| `already_launched` | 409 | The project has launched, so it cannot launch again or be deleted; `existing` holds it. | Add directories with `POST /projects/{project_id}/listings` instead. |
| `project_exists` | 409 | Another project has the same `url`, `contact_email` or `external_id`; `param` names the field and `existing` holds that project. | Use `existing`, or change the field. |
| `idempotency_key_in_use` | 409 | A request with this `Idempotency-Key` is still running. | Retry in 1 second with the same key. |
| `gone` | 410 | The report file expired after 7 days, or the path belongs to a retired API. | Build a new report, or follow `doc_url` to the path that replaced it. |
| `cursor_expired` | 410 | The cursor points to events older than 90 days. | Read the objects you track again, then read the feed without a cursor. |
| `unsupported_media_type` | 415 | The body is not `application/json`, or for images not `multipart/form-data`. | Set `Content-Type` to match the body. |
| `validation_failed` | 422 | Fields are invalid; `errors` lists each one with its `param` and `code`. | Fix each field in `errors` and send the request again. |
| `not_ready` | 422 | The project misses something a launch needs; `errors` lists it. Nothing was spent. | Add what is missing. `readiness.missing` shows the same list. |
| `nothing_to_submit` | 422 | No directory in the catalog fits the project now. Nothing was spent. | Check `unlocks` and `not_matching` in the readiness preview, change the project, and try again. |
| `invalid_directories` | 422 | Some directory ids are unknown, outside the catalog, not open to the project or already used; `errors` lists them. Nothing was spent. | Remove them and send the request again. |
| `allowance_exhausted` | 422 | The project has no free allowance: listings use or reserve all of it, or it has not launched. | Wait for listings to end; `not_accepted` and `cancelled` listings give theirs back. |
| `badge_not_found` | 422 | We read the site and did not find the badge. | Run `check_command`, fix the install, and verify again. |
| `image_unreachable` | 422 | We could not download an image from the URL. | Check that the URL is public and returns an image, or upload the file instead. |
| `endpoint_url_invalid` | 422 | The webhook URL is not a public `https` URL. | Use `https`, a public host, and no user name or password in the URL. |
| `idempotency_key_reused` | 422 | This `Idempotency-Key` came with a different request before. | Use a new key for each new request. |
| `quota_exceeded` | 422 | Before your first purchase, test mode allows 25 projects, 100 new projects a day and 3 webhook endpoints. | Delete test data in the console, wait for the next day, or buy launches. |
| `rate_limited` | 429 | Too many requests this hour, or too many calls to an operation with its own limit. | Wait the seconds in `Retry-After`. |
| `internal_error` | 500 | Something failed on our side. | Retry with backoff; quote `request_id` if it repeats. |
| `unavailable` | 503 | The API is down for a short time. | Retry after the seconds in `Retry-After`. |

param.description: The field, as a path such as `tagline`, `competitors[2].url` or `directories.include[0]`.

code.description:
What is wrong with the field. The list is closed.

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `required` | The field is missing or empty. |
| `invalid` | The value is not allowed here; `message` says why. |
| `invalid_enum` | The value is not one of the listed values. |
| `invalid_url` | Not an `http` or `https` URL. |
| `not_public_url` | Live mode only: the host is an IP address or a reserved name such as `.test`. |
| `invalid_email` | Not an email address. |
| `too_short` | Shorter than the minimum length. |
| `too_long` | Longer than the maximum length. |
| `too_many` | The list has more items than allowed. |
| `immutable` | The field cannot change any more, such as `contact_email` after launch. |
| `file_too_large` | The image is larger than 5 MB. |
| `unsupported_file_type` | The file is not a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image. |
| `import_failed` | We could not download an image from the URL. |

message.description: A sentence that says what is wrong and how to fix it.

Error.description: The body of every 4xx and 5xx response, unknown paths and malformed JSON included. Branch on `error.code`; `error.message` is for people and can change.

code.description: The stable code. See the table in `ErrorCode`.

message.description: A sentence that says what happened and what to do. Show it to people; never parse it.

param.description: The parameter at fault, when there is one. Absent otherwise.

errors.description: Every field that needs fixing, on `validation_failed`, `not_ready` and `invalid_directories`. Absent otherwise.

existing.description: The project in the way, on `project_exists` and `already_launched`. Absent otherwise.

doc_url.description: The section of the error reference for this code.

request_id.description: The request's id, the same as the `X-Request-Id` header. Quote it when you contact support.
